$comment: Pre-existing findings of tests/explorer.spec.js that are reported but do not fail it. Each entry: role, page ('*' = any), check, an optional 'match' substring of the finding's detail, the finding id it is tracked under (docs/testing/COVERAGE_MATRIX.md), and why. This list may only shrink: fix the defect, delete the entry. An entry that no longer reproduces is reported as 'remove me' by scripts/summarize.js. BUG-0010/BUG-0011 (an org slug twice in a link) are never listed here.
